title: AI assistants for sermon and Bible-study preparation
why: AI can help organise research, suggest outlines, explain historical context and draft study questions — saving hours each week.
what_is_different: Faith leaders must check every reference against the text and trusted commentaries, guard their own voice and theological convictions, and never outsource discernment. AI can misquote verses.

extra_modules.title: Research, not replacement
extra_modules.outcome: You can: use AI as a research assistant
extra_modules.practice: Generate study questions for a passage and verify every reference

starter_project: Build a weekly preparation workflow: passage study in your scripture tool, AI-assisted outline and questions, verification against the text, and your own final draft.
pitfalls: Quoting verses from AI without checking

expert_validation.note: AI-drafted outline; to be validated by a practitioner and an educator in this field.
